# bercon-cli

Command-line client for servers using BattlEye RCon.

## Server profiles

Use `[globals]` for shared values and `[profile.NAME]` for each server.
Select profiles with `--profile NAME` and config files with `--config PATH`.

When `--config/-c` is omitted, search these paths in order:

### Linux / BSD

1. If `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is set, use `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/bercon-cli/config.ini`;
   otherwise, use `~/.config/bercon-cli/config.ini`.
2. `~/.bercon-cli.ini`

### macOS

1. `~/Library/Application Support/bercon-cli/config.ini`
2. If `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is set, use `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/bercon-cli/config.ini`;
   otherwise, use `~/.config/bercon-cli/config.ini`.
3. `~/.bercon-cli.ini`

### Windows

1. If `%APPDATA%` is set, use `%APPDATA%\bercon-cli\config.ini`.
2. If `%XDG_CONFIG_HOME%` is set, use `%XDG_CONFIG_HOME%\bercon-cli\config.ini`;
   otherwise, use `%USERPROFILE%\.config\bercon-cli\config.ini`.
3. `%USERPROFILE%\.bercon-cli.ini`

## Configuration priority

Parameter priority, lowest to highest:

1. Built-in default values
2. Variables loaded from the `.env` file
3. Environment variables set in your shell or service
4. Shared settings in the INI configuration file (`[globals]` section)
5. Settings in the selected server profile in that INI file
6. Connection settings from the BattlEye config
7. Command-line flags

## NAME

**bercon-cli**

## SYNOPSIS

`bercon-cli [OPTIONS]`

## OPTIONS

### Connection

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`-i`, `--ip`|RCon server IP address or hostname|`127.0.0.1`|`$BERCON_ADDRESS`|no|
|`-P`, `--password`|BattlEye RCon password||`$BERCON_PASSWORD`|no|
|`-p`, `--port`|BattlEye RCon server port|`2305`|`$BERCON_PORT`|no|
|`-t`, `--timeout`|Timeout for login and command responses|`3s`|`$BERCON_TIMEOUT`|no|
|`-a`, `--attempts`|Number of login attempts|`1`|`$BERCON_ATTEMPTS`|no|
|`-k`, `--keepalive`|Keepalive interval (<45s; 0 disables)|`30s`|`$BERCON_KEEPALIVE`|no|
|`-b`, `--buffer-size`|Reserved option **(deprecated: ignored)**||`$BERCON_BUFFER_SIZE`|no|

### Output

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`-f`, `--format`|Output format; choices: `table, json, raw, md, html, csv`|`table`|`$BERCON_FORMAT`|no|

### Profile and config

|Option|Description|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|
|`-n`, `--profile`|Select a profile from the INI config file|`$BERCON_PROFILE`|no|
|`-c`, `--config`|Read connection settings from this INI file|`$BERCON_CONFIG`|no|
|`-r`, `--server-cfg`|Read RCon settings from a BattlEye config||no|
|`-l`, `--list-profiles`|List profiles and exit||no|
|`-e`, `--example`|Print an example INI profile and exit||no|

### GeoIP

|Option|Description|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|
|`-g`, `--geo-db`|Path to the GeoIP MMDB file|`$BERCON_GEO_DB`|no|
|`-G`, `--geo-db-url`|HTTPS URL for downloading or updating the GeoIP database|`$BERCON_GEO_DB_URL`|no|
|`--geo-db-url-auth`|MaxMind account ID and license key|`$BERCON_GEO_DB_URL_AUTH`|no|

### Env Options

|Option|Description|Default|Required|
|---|---|---|---|
|`--env-file FILE`|Path to .env file|`.env`|no|
|`--no-env`|Disable .env file loading||no|
|`--env-override`|Override existing environment variables from .env file||no|

### Help Options

|Option|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`-h`, `--help`|Show this help message|no|
|`-v`, `--version`|Show version information|no|

## COMMANDS

**Help Commands**

### help

Show help

**Usage:** `bercon-cli [OPTIONS] help`

### version

Show version information

**Usage:** `bercon-cli [OPTIONS] version [version-OPTIONS]`

#### Show version information

|Option|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`--short`|Print version number only|no|
|`--commit`|Print commit SHA only|no|
|`--json`|Print version information as JSON|no|

### completion

Generate shell completion

**Usage:** `bercon-cli [OPTIONS] completion [completion-OPTIONS]`

#### Generate shell completion

|Option|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`--shell`|Shell completion format; choices: `bash, zsh, pwsh`|no|

#### Arguments

|Name|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`output`|Output file path|no|

### exec

Execute RCon commands

**Usage:** `bercon-cli [OPTIONS] exec [exec-OPTIONS]`

#### Examples

Connect directly to a server

```shell
bercon-cli exec --ip 192.0.2.10 --port 2305 --password '<RCON_PASSWORD>' players
```

Run a command against a saved profile

```shell
bercon-cli exec --profile dayz-local players
```

Pass a command with spaces to the server

```shell
bercon-cli exec --profile arma3-eu -- 'say -1 Server restart in 5 minutes'
```

#### Execute RCon commands

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`-x`, `--repeat`|Batches to run (-1 repeats forever)|`1`|`$BERCON_REPEAT`|no|
|`-s`, `--cmd-sleep`|Delay between commands|`1ms`|`$BERCON_SLEEP_CMD`|no|
|`-S`, `--loop-sleep`|Delay between batches|`5s`|`$BERCON_SLEEP_LOOP`|no|

### shell

Start an interactive RCon session

**Usage:** `bercon-cli [OPTIONS] shell [shell-OPTIONS]`

#### Examples

```shell
bercon-cli shell --profile dayz-local
```

#### Start an interactive RCon session

|Option|Description|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|
|`--no-builtins`|Send CLI built-in commands such as exit and quit to the server|`$BERCON_NO_BUILTINS`|no|

### watch

Read server messages

**Usage:** `bercon-cli [OPTIONS] watch [watch-OPTIONS]`

#### Examples

```shell
bercon-cli watch --profile dayz-local --timestamps >> dayz-watch.log
```

#### Read server messages

|Option|Description|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|
|`--timestamps`|Prefix server messages with local timestamps (RFC 3339)|`$BERCON_TIMESTAMPS`|no|
